summary: A legal trace contains at most ten actions, so listener-management scaling cannot be measured honestly; each emission visits its k active listeners once and forwards its a arguments once per callback.

workload_bound.source_constraint: actions.length is between one and ten, so at most nine subscriptions or unsubscriptions can accompany construction.

replacement_checks.evidence: Subscription appends once, unsubscription searches and removes within a listener list bounded by the ten-action trace, and emission snapshots and invokes each active listener exactly once while forwarding all arguments.
Cases cover empty events, optional zero arguments, multiple arguments, ordered listeners, first and middle removal, event isolation, and preservation of unrelated subscriptions.
